description: TI TPS61088 — 10A synchronous boost converter, 2.7-12V input, up to 12.6V output. VQFN-20 package. Integrated 11mΩ/13mΩ power MOSFETs. For high-current boost: USB-PD, battery-to-5V, LED backlight.
name: tps61088
watch_out_for: VQFN-20 center pad: reflow only, thermal vias. Hot-loop layout critical: keep SW/input loop tight; 1uH-2.2uH high-current inductor.
